responsibility: Implements the generic SSA propagation framework used by several tree SSA optimizers such as CCP and copy propagation. It manages CFG and SSA-edge worklists, executable-edge simulation, statement and PHI revisitation, safe const/copy propagation predicates, value replacement helpers for statements and trees, substitution-and-fold support, and loop-closed PHI cleanup, providing reusable propagation infrastructure rather than a specific optimization policy.
same_name_distinction: Implements the generic SSA propagation engine and related helpers: worklists, statement/PHI simulation, replacement routines, propagation legality checks, and loop-closed-PHI cleanup. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-propagate.h, it contains the engine behavior and helper bodies rather than the abstract interface and declarations.
